passages.text: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this Form 10-K. This discussion, particularly information with respect to our future results of operations or financial condition, business strategy and plans, and objectives of management for future operations, includes forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties as described under the heading “Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements” in this Form 10-K. As a result of many factors, including, without limitation, those factors set forth in Part I, Item 1A. “Risk Factors” in this Form 10-K, our actual results or timing of certain events could differ materially from the results or timing described in, or implied by, these forward-looking statements. In the following discussion and analysis, amounts may not foot due to rounding. Page Overview 47 Key Business Metrics 49 Results of Operations 50 Non-GAAP Financial Measures 54 Liquidity and Capital Resources 56 Critical Accounting Estimates 58 Recently Adopted Accounting Pronouncements 60 Overview Coupang is a technology and Fortune 150 company listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CPNG) that provides retail, restaurant delivery, video streaming, and fintech services to customers around the world under brands that include Coupang, Eats, Play, Rocket Now, and Farfetch. Headquartered in the United States, Coupang has operations and support services in geographies including Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, China, India, Japan, and Europe. Coupang’s mission is to revolutionize the everyday lives of its customers and create a world where people wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” We believe that we are a preeminent retail destination because of our broad selection, low prices, and exceptional delivery and customer experience across our owned inventory selection as well as products offered by third-party merchants. Our unique end-to-end integrated fulfillment, logistics, and technology network enables Rocket Delivery, which provides free, next-day delivery for orders placed anytime of the day, even seconds before midnight—across millions of products in Korea. Our structural advantages from complete end-to-end integration, investments in technology, and scale economies generate higher efficiencies that allow us to pass savings to customers in the form of lower prices. The capabilities we have built provide us with opportunities to expand into other offerings and geographies. Data Incident and Customer Compensation Program In November 2025, Coupang became aware of a data incident involving unauthorized access to customer accounts (the “Incident”). passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Investing in our Class A common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should consider and read carefully all of the risks, uncertainties, events, and contingencies described below, as well as other information included in this Form 10-K, including the sections titled “Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements,” “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” and our consolidated financial statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this Form 10-K, before making an investment decision. The risks, uncertainties, events, and contingencies described below may not be the only ones we face. Our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects, as well as the price of our Class A common stock could also be affected by additional factors that apply to all companies operating globally. The occurrence of any of the following, or additional, risks, uncertainties, events, and contingencies not presently known to us, or that we currently believe to be immaterial, or that apply to all companies operating globally could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects, as well as the price of our Class A common stock which would cause you to lose all or part of your investment. Some of the risks, uncertainties, events, and contingencies discussed below may have occurred in the past, but the descriptions below are not representations as to whether or not the risks, uncertainties, events, or contingencies have occurred in the past and instead reflect our beliefs and opinions as to the risks, uncertainties, events, and contingencies that could materially and adversely affect us in the future. Summary Risk Factors Our business faces significant risks, uncertainties, events, and contingencies. The risk factors described below are only a summary of the principal risk factors associated with investing in our Class A common stock. These risks are more fully described in this “Risk Factors” section, including the following: • our results of operations may fluctuate significantly, which makes our future results of operations and prospects difficult to predict and could cause our results of operations to fall below expectations; • our business is rapidly evolving, and we plan to continue to forgo short-term financial performance for long-term growth, which makes it difficult to evaluate our future prospects and predict our future results of operations, including our revenue growth rate; • we may be unable to effectively manage the continued growth of our workforce, operations, and infrastructure, including the development, acquisition, and management of new business initiatives; • we have had a history of net losses, and we may not maintain profitability in future periods; • because a majority of our operations take place in Korea and are subject to Korean law, there are circumstances in which certain of our Korean affiliates’ executives may be held either directly or vicariously criminally liable for the actions of our Korean affiliates or our Korean affiliates’ executives and employees; • we face intense competition and could lose m

credit_strengths.text: Coupang's net cash position is a core credit strength, with unrestricted cash and short-term investments exceeding total interest-bearing debt by a wide margin. This provides substantial liquidity to absorb the disclosed data-incident compensation costs and ongoing growth investments without incremental borrowing. The resulting negative net leverage places the company far stronger than the Consumer Discretionary sector median, supporting a minimal indicative financial risk profile.

Operating cash flow remains solidly positive and covers capital expenditure, leaving free cash flow that comfortably exceeds reported interest expense. Interest coverage is adequate, though it sits below the sector median, reflecting thin operating margins. The cash-generative core retail and delivery operations underpin debt-servicing capacity despite ongoing investment in fulfillment and technology infrastructure.

key_risks.text: The November data incident and the Korean subsidiary's customer compensation program represent a concrete, disclosed risk. The program is expected to cost approximately one point two billion dollars, a material cash outflow relative to free cash flow. This could pressure near-term liquidity and distract management, even though the net cash position provides a buffer against the immediate financial impact.

Debt structure is short-dated: the maturity profile shows no repayment due in the next twelve months, but a substantial portion falls due in year three, with a smaller amount in year two. This creates refinancing concentration risk. Additionally, operating lease liabilities are excluded from reported debt but are significant, and the Altman Z double prime zone indicates distress, warranting caution.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Free cash flow to debt is strong, exceeding the sector median, and interest coverage is adequate. However, operating cash flow has declined over the past two years while debt has increased, a trend that bears monitoring. The company's substantial cash balance provides a cushion, but the declining cash flow trend could erode debt-servicing metrics if not reversed.

The debt maturity profile is manageable in the near term, with no maturities in the next twelve months, but a significant balloon payment in year three requires refinancing or cash reserves. Given the net cash position, the company can likely self-fund this maturity, but the concentration warrants attention. Lease liabilities, though excluded from debt, add fixed obligations that compete for cash flow.

overall_credit_view.text: Coupang's credit profile is anchored by a net cash balance sheet and positive free cash flow, supporting a minimal indicative financial risk profile. The company's scale in Korean e-commerce and expanding offerings provide revenue diversity. However, thin operating margins, declining operating cash flow, and the disclosed data incident introduce near-term uncertainty. The net cash position provides a strong buffer against these challenges.

We view the credit as investment grade in quality, though not rated, given the net cash position and adequate coverage. The main risks are the data incident compensation, short-dated debt maturities, and declining cash flow trend. We expect the company to maintain sufficient liquidity to meet obligations, but monitor the impact of the compensation program and any further cash outflows. The indicative risk profile is not a rating.

credit_strengths.text: Coupang的淨現金狀況為核心信用優勢，其不受限制現金及短期投資大幅超過總計息債務。此提供充裕流動性以吸收已披露的數據事件賠償成本及持續增長投資，而無需新增借貸。由此產生的負淨槓桿使該公司遠強於非必需消費品行業中位數，支撐最低的指示性財務風險狀況。
營運現金流保持穩健正值並覆蓋資本開支，留下自由現金流，從容超過報告利息支出。利息覆蓋率充足，儘管低於行業中位數，反映營運利潤率偏薄。具現金生成能力的核心零售及配送業務支撐償債能力，儘管持續投資於履約及技術基礎設施。

key_risks.text: 十一月數據事件及韓國子公司客戶賠償計劃代表一項具體且已披露的風險。該計劃預計耗資約十億美元，相對於自由現金流屬重大現金流出。此可能對近期流動性構成壓力並分散管理層注意力，儘管淨現金狀況提供緩衝以應對即時財務影響。
債務結構偏短期：到期情況顯示未來十二個月內並無還款到期，但相當部分於第三年到期，第二年有較小金額。此造成再融資集中風險。此外，營運租賃負債雖從報告債務中排除，但金額重大，而Altman Z雙素區間顯示困境，值得警惕。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 自由現金流對債務比率強勁，超過行業中位數，利息覆蓋率充足。然而，營運現金流於過去兩年下降而債務增加，此趨勢值得監察。該公司龐大現金結餘提供緩衝，但若現金流下降趨勢未能扭轉，可能侵蝕償債指標。
債務到期情況於近期內可控，未來十二個月內並無到期，但第三年有一筆重大氣球式還款，需要再融資或現金儲備。鑑於淨現金狀況，該公司可能可自行支付此到期款項，但集中度值得關注。租賃負債雖從債務中排除，但增加固定義務，與現金流競爭。

overall_credit_view.text: Coupang的信用狀況以淨現金資產負債表及正自由現金流為錨，支撐最低的指示性財務風險狀況。該公司在韓國電子商務的規模及不斷擴展的產品供應提供收入多元性。然而，營運利潤率偏薄、營運現金流下降及已披露的數據事件引入近期不確定性。淨現金狀況為這些挑戰提供強大緩衝。
我們認為該信用具投資級質量，儘管並無評級，鑑於淨現金狀況及充足覆蓋率。主要風險為數據事件賠償、短期債務到期及現金流下降趨勢。我們預期該公司維持足夠流動性以履行義務，但監察賠償計劃的影響及任何進一步現金流出。指示性風險狀況並非評級。
